newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cypriots protest at British base over arrest.
newsitem.headline: Cypriots protest at British base over arrest.

text.p: Greek Cypriots protested outside a police station in a British military base on the island on Friday demanding the release of a teenager jailed for traffic offences, witnesses said.
Around 30 people demanded the release of 17-year-old George Dimitri Kyriakou who is serving a three month sentence in a base jail.
Britain has retained two military bases in the south and southeast of Cyprus since it gained independence in 1960. A police force is empowered to prosecute any offender within bases territory.
Many Cypriots do not recognise the authority of the British bases in passing judgement on them.

The demonstrators, some of them motorcyclists, hung Greek and Cypriot flags on the gate of the police station at Dhekelia in the southeast of the island, and warned they would return on Sunday for a larger protest.
Kyriakou's parents and a member of parliament also took part in the protest.
A plea for clemency by the lawyer and parents of the youth is being considered by the bases commander, a spokesman for the bases said.
